characterList.name: Boris Johnson

content_metadata.description: An interview with Boris Johnson discussing the state of British businesses and his visions for economic growth and government involvement.

activities.description: Boris Johnson responds to the interviewer's questions.

characterInteraction.description: The interviewer poses questions that prompt Boris Johnson's opinions and views on the economy and the role of the government.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene is set at a business conference with Boris Johnson discussing economic topics.

narrativeProgression.description: The interviewer asks Boris Johnson about the state of businesses in London and the UK.
Boris Johnson emphasizes the achievements of British businesses, especially exporters.
Boris Johnson urges the government to shift away from austerity rhetoric and instead focus on promoting economic growth.
Boris Johnson praises the CBI conference for drawing attention to the needs and views of British industry.

scenes.thematicElements: Economic optimism and celebrating business achievements. The need for government action and investment. A call for a positive and ambitious outlook.

climax.description: The climax occurs when Boris Johnson directly addresses the government, urging them to shift their approach from austerity to one of growth and investment.

storylines.description: Celebrating British Business and Urging for a Positive Outlook

content_metadata.title: Boris Johnson on British Businesses

trimmingSuggestions.description: While expressing appreciation for the CBI conference is relevant, this segment could be trimmed to maintain a tighter focus on Boris Johnson's core message about the economy and government action.

youtube_description:
At the CBI Annual Conference, the Mayor of London says the lesson from the Olympics is to 'not give in to the doomsters and gloomsters' - and goes on to pay tribute to the event, which he says 'he has never known so well attended or to have generated so much media interest' and goes on to 'congratulate the CBI on what they are doing to draw attention to the needs and views of British industry on whom, frankly, we all rely'.
You can read more about the CBI's Annual Conference here - http://www.cbi.org.uk/events/cbi-annual-conference-2012/
youtube_title: Boris Johnson interview: 'I congratulate the CBI'
